rationale: No sound, nonredundant postcondition is available under these bounds. Deep-view equality is inherited from DeepViewClone; raw set or cardinality equality would require K::deep_clone to preserve concrete Eq/Hash identity, which its contract does not guarantee.
risks: The inherited guarantee is trusted because the implementation uses external_body.
Concrete membership and cardinality may change if cloned elements collide under Eq/Hash.
